queries.query: "large language model" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network configuration generation")
queries.rationale: Locate papers applying LLMs directly to network configuration, intent-to-configuration translation, or NetOps tasks to map the immediate phenomenon and track recent model-driven NetOps work.

queries.query: ("intent to configuration" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent driven networking" OR "intent-based networking") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model")
queries.rationale: Find prior and recent research on intent-driven NetOps and any integration with generative models, to situate translation/semantic-mapping problems and task formulations.

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-validate" OR "generate-validate" OR "generate-and-repair") AND (network OR "network configuration" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Survey architectures that combine generation with verification/repair (pipeline patterns) applied to network configurations or related operational artifacts.

queries.query: Batfish OR "configuration verification" OR "network verification" OR "formal verification" AND (reachability OR isolation OR policy compliance)
queries.rationale: Collect foundational and applied works on deterministic/configuration validators and verification tools that can serve as mitigators or oracles in NetOps workflows.

queries.query: (misconfiguration OR "configuration error" OR "network failure" OR outage) AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "generative AI" OR hallucination)
queries.rationale: Identify documented failure modes where generative models produce incorrect or unsafe network changes, and case studies linking hallucination to operational risk.

queries.query: ("tool-augmented" OR "tool-assisted" OR "tool use") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (verification OR "self-correction" OR "refinement")
queries.rationale: Find methods where LLMs call external tools (verifiers, simulators, linters) to check or correct outputs—relevant mitigation strategies for NetOps.

queries.query: (constrained generation OR "constrained decoding" OR "controlled generation" OR "safe decoding") AND (LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Gather techniques for restricting model outputs (decoding constraints, safety filters, templates) applicable to producing safe configs or commands.

queries.query: ("agentic" OR "agentic AI" OR agent) AND (NetOps OR "network operations" OR "autonomous operations" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Map literature on autonomous/agentic systems for operational tasks, orchestration frameworks, and how agency changes responsibility and verification needs.

queries.query: (benchmark OR evaluation OR dataset) AND ("LLM for networking" OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "AIOps benchmark" OR "network configuration dataset")
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites used to test LLMs/AIOps on networking tasks to assess benchmark validity and gaps.

queries.query: (Mininet OR ns-3 OR Emulab OR DeterLab OR "network simulator" OR "network emulator") AND ("evaluation" OR "testbed" OR "NetOps")
queries.rationale: Identify simulation/emulation environments and testbeds used to execute or validate network configuration changes—candidates for experimental validation in NetOps studies.

queries.query: ("configuration repair" OR "repair network config" OR "configuration synthesis") AND (dataset OR benchmark OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Locate datasets and prior tasks specifically about repairing or synthesizing network configurations to support reproducible experiments and realism assessments.

queries.query: ("evaluation metrics" OR "operational correctness" OR "policy compliance" OR reachability OR "safety metric") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Aggregate proposed metrics and validators that measure operational correctness, safety, policy adherence, and real-world relevance of generated configs.

queries.query: (hallucination OR "factually incorrect" OR "wrong code" OR "wrong config") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (mitigation OR "error analysis" OR "failure modes")
queries.rationale: Collect general LLM failure-mode analyses and mitigation strategies to transfer lessons to NetOps contexts (e.g., calibration, uncertainty estimation).

queries.query: ("prompt engineering" OR "chain-of-thought" OR CoT OR "few-shot" OR "in-context learning") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Survey prompting strategies and their sensitivity—important for construct validity and internal-threat assessment when LLMs are asked to produce network artifacts.

queries.query: ("guardrails" OR "policy engine" OR "runtime guard" OR "execution sandbox") AND (agent OR LLM OR "autonomous agent") AND (operations OR NetOps OR "network change")
queries.rationale: Find architectural patterns that enforce runtime constraints or policies on agentic outputs—useful mitigations and system-design patterns for NetOps agents.

queries.query: ("AIOps" OR "Autonomic networking" OR "closed-loop" OR "intent-driven") AND (survey OR review)
queries.rationale: Identify surveys and syntheses of the broader AIOps/autonomic networking literature to position neighbouring work, historical context, and gaps relevant to agentic LLM adoption.
source_preferences: IEEE surveys, ACM surveys, arXiv, Google Scholar

queries.query: ("ethical" OR "safety" OR "governance" OR "disclosure") AND ("agentic AI" OR "autonomous agents" OR LLM) AND (operations OR safety-critical OR infrastructure)
queries.rationale: Collect governance, disclosure, and safety-position literature to inform mandatory disclosure practices and ethical threat analysis for agentic NetOps research.
source_preferences: AI policy venues, arXiv, IEEE, ACM

inclusion_criteria: Primary-source peer-reviewed publications (IEEE, ACM, USENIX, major conferences/journals) and arXiv/tech reports with verifiable authorship and metadata
Public datasets, code repositories, and tool documentation (GitHub, Zenodo, project websites) that provide reproducible artifacts

Work directly addressing LLM/Generative-AI applications to NetOps, network-configuration synthesis/repair, verification tools (e.g., Batfish), simulation/testbed evaluation, and AIOps/agentic operation design
Surveys, systematic reviews, and benchmarks relevant to AIOps, evaluation metrics, and NetOps automation
Papers and preprints from 2018–2026 for LLM-focused content, with earlier foundational work (pre-2018) allowed for networking verification and formal-methods context
Sources in English or with an official English translation
Publicly accessible incident reports or reproducible case studies documenting misconfigurations or failures relevant to NetOps
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing materials, vendor claims, or press releases lacking verifiable methods or data
Social-media posts, unverifiable blog snippets, or anecdotal accounts without primary artifacts or citations
Proprietary internal reports or datasets that are not publicly accessible (unless a public summary with verifiable metadata exists)
Non-English material without translation or reliable metadata (unless critical and translatable)
Papers that only evaluate generic LLM language capabilities on trivia-style networking questions without operational task grounding (unless used for background)
Works that postdate the planned search cutoff for the study period unless needed for late-breaking context (see date rationale)
date_rationale: Focus on 2018–2026 for LLM-related NetOps work because practical large-scale generative models and their tool-using paradigms emerged after the Transformer era; allow earlier publications (pre-2018) for foundational network verification, formal methods, and classic NetOps automation research (e.g., Batfish, model-checking approaches). This balances capturing recent LLM-driven advances while retaining seminal networking verification literature for mechanisms and mitigations.
